limitations: Campaign acceptance remains INCONCLUSIVE; this is a storage-only projection.
The index covers all published result JSON documents and their named/nested attempt observations, not unpublished controller history.
Repeated identical observations of one named attempt are merged with every source pointer retained. Changed observations and anonymous records remain distinct.
Record/index entry counts are not independent trial counts. Text-only history and per-request traces remain in the byte-preserved original archive.
Only declared sample distributions are recomputed. Other retained results are explicitly reported frozen values, not independently requalified quality or statistics.
Original private models, media, raw receipts and runtime records were not published; archiving does not restore them or complete outstanding acceptance.
